An Ethiopian Airlines flight to Nairobi has crashed with 149 passengers and eight crew members aboard six minutes after taking off.

The state-owned Ethiopian Airlines calls itself Africa's largest carrier and has ambitions of becoming the gateway to the continent.

Its last major crash was in January 2010, when a flight from Beirut went down shortly after take-off.

The death toll is unclear at this stage.

Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has expressed his condolences to the families of those onboard.

Mr Ahmed's office issued a statement shortly after the incident saying the plane was on a regularly scheduled flight when it crashed. The statement gave no further details.
